newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy govt to take stock of welfare talks July 29.
newsitem.headline: Italy govt to take stock of welfare talks July 29.

text.p: The Italian government, employers groups and trades unions will formally take stock on July 29 of progress to date in negotiations to reform the welfare state, political sources said on Tuesday.
Ministers earlier began a first round of talks with union leaders on pension reform, potentially the thorniest issue in the whole negotiations.
Political sources said talks were focused on the division between social security and pensions. An analysis of a partial pension reform carried out in 1995 will be studied later by technical experts.

Italy is under stiff pressure to carry out a convincing reform of social spending and shake up its pensions system to prove that public finances will be kept under control before the planned 1999 launch of the single European currency.
The welfare talks were officially opened in June but proper discussions only got underway this month.
